subject: average covariate per segment in dsm analysis

messages.author: 0a606ccf0fbbf52f
messages.subject: average covariate per segment in dsm analysis
parts:
Dear all,

I'm trying to perform a dsm analysis on a line-transect distance sampling dataset.

I have a question that might be straightforward to some of you. I'm trying to get a covariate value for each segment of the my transects. My understanding is that the best way to do so would be to compute an average of this covariate across the squared segment (segment length * 2 * truncation distance).

Would you agree? Would you suggest some R script of package that would help me to do so easily, unless you have other suggestions?

Consider that I have a raster reporting the grid covariate values across my study region.

Thank you

Gabriele
